notes.title: Emoji Update!
notes.content:
Add a little extra character to your Duck Race, with the Emoji update!
!quack during a race will now make your little racer show some emotion. Options are:
[list]
[*] !quack cool
[*] !quack cry
[*] !quack angry
[*] !quack laugh
[*] !quack love
[*] !quack wink
[*] !quack grin
[/list]

Let your audience know, and let us know what you think in the Discord or on X!

notes.title: Duck, Duck, Ghost!
notes.content:
Sorry, we're quite limited when it comes to Halloween duck puns...

This is the *official* Halloween update, bringing you a selection of spooky costumes for your little ducks, and a couple of maps which you may or may not have seen before!

The all encompassing "sheet ghost" costume has been removed, allowing streamers to select a ghostly duck as a skin option instead. It also comes in "accessory", so [b]!duckhat ghost [/b] to continue the scares.

[u]Hat Options[/u]
[list]
[*] ghost
[*] greg (Over the Garden Wall)
[*] wirt (Over the Garden Wall)
[*] pirate
[*] pumpkin
[*] witch
[*] horns
[*] wraith
[/list]

[u]Map Options[/u]
[list]
[*] Graveyard (from last year)
[*] Heathen (previously exclusive map for DJ Descent)
[/list]

notes.title: Hoppy Easter
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Easter![/h1]

Some long awaited content has finally landed! We're excited to share our latest map: Eggstravaganza!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42975012/73e62b34c002d1d46177c38d2c4a786578702d79.png[/img]

A much longer and windier map than what you might be used to, but this is the first to proper utilise the new way we build our maps - allowing for greater variety in various segments of the track.

Also, as it is Easter, we have a new Eggciting treat! Unlike last year's egg hunt, your painted ovum will spawn near your ducks, adding a nice layer of chaos to all races (and maybe some Battle Royale, too).

Finally - a few returning favourites in the Hat Box: Bunny Ears, Egg, and the Easter bonnet!

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!

It's been a while since we added any new features or content, so today we are giving you (for a limited time only!) some new spooky Halloween hats, and a BRAND NEW Graveyard map, designed by BellaTrellia!

Hats:
Horns - a regular offering, but bundled together with the other seasonal accessories!
Pumpkin - or "Jack-O-Lantern", depending on where you're from.
Witch - a spooky witches hat.
Wirt - A full costume made in homage to Over The Garden Wall
Greg - The lovable little brother of Wirt

notes.title: More bug fixes, and public gratitude
notes.content:
Fixed a few more bugs in BtR (mostly created by the last patch)
[list]
[*] Ducks will now be properly eliminated when they hit the floor and plug hole whirlpool
[*] Ducks should no longer be able to linger under the tap or on the edge of a full bath (requires live testing)
[*] Reduced eliminated duck name opacity - a little easier on the eye
[*] Ducks should sink properly/always when eliminated
[*] Duck hat should now appear on Winner screen
[/list]

Also added is a new custom hat for Twitch.tv/Pokerbrahs as thanks for all the testing and suggestions from them and their community. Try out [i]!duckhat pokerbrahs[/i] and don't forget to check out their poker streams if you get a chance!

notes.title: Three Little Ducks - v2.2.2
notes.content:
[b][u]Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Water wheels moving faster as originally intended.
[*] Bath toys now appearing in bathroom mirror.
[*] Ducks will no longer gather by the Wraith tub.
[*] Bringing up the results before the end now unlocks the mouse cursor.
[*] Bathtub Royale results now being tracked correctly (internal)
[*] Finish button now always returns to menu if the race hasn't been started.
[/list].

[u][b]Upgrades[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Duck HP (BtR only) will now scale with the amount of ducks.
[*] Elimination text (BtR only) added to bottom left.
[*] Esc key now brings up results same as Tab (more intuitive)
[/list]

Special thanks to BarronVonCheese and PokerBrahs for helping realise these issues.

[/list]

notes.title: Early big fixes and new sound effects!
notes.content:
Some early bugs were spotted and have been fixed, see below full list of changes
[list]
[*] !IMPORTANT! - Q and Space have now been switched - Q will show/hide duck names while Space will raise the camera. This feels more intuitive (jumping, init?)
[*] Snowy Beaks previously unable to Finish race - this is now fixed
[*] Some ducks could get stuck in the sand castle of Quackpool Pleasure - added current to encourage them out.
[*] Fixed duck textures
[*] Invisible issue related to Twitch connection resolved, don't worry about it
[*] Improved textures in Quackatoa
[*] Added more sound effects as requested by Jamie Spector
[*] Extra logging for !duckname issue - please get in touch if you experience issues with Duck names.
[/list]
